source: Hand-written seed corpus. Replace with a real dataset via scripts/import_jobs.py.
notes: 26 postings covering every role family the profile classifier needs.
Each `category` value becomes a role label, so keep them consistent -
adding a one-off category with a single posting produces a role profile
built from one sample, which the classifier will then over-fit to.
`experience_years` is the MINIMUM the posting asks for. The recommender
filters on it so students can hide senior roles.
